# Local 3D dependency

Three.js **0.180.0**, MIT license. Files are vendored so the studio does not depend on a CDN at runtime.

- `three.module.js`, `three.core.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/
- `OrbitControls.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js
- License: `THREE-LICENSE.txt`
- API reference: https://threejs.org/docs/pages/WebGLRenderer.html

PC orbit controls and WebGL rendering are implemented. This build does not claim tested headset/WebXR support.
